content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Beaumont

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of project management education hours. Critically: no prior work experience is required, making CAPM ideal for career changers and early-career professionals entering Beaumont's refining, healthcare, and maritime sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format compresses the required contact hours into an efficient schedule, allowing working professionals in Beaumont to earn certification without lengthy part-time commitments or travel.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and apply for CAPM candidacy through their official portal. You'll provide proof of your secondary degree and completion of the required education hours, then pay the PMI exam fee to activate your candidacy window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy equips you with study materials and exam-preparation guidance. The CAPM exam tests your knowledge of project management frameworks and best practices. Upon passing, you earn the credential immediately and join PMI's professional community.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM certification is valid for three years. Maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) through ongoing training, conference attendance, or volunteer project management work. Renewal keeps your credential current and demonstrates commitment to professional growth.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
